rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Bounding
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

rules.name: Bounding Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bounding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Decimate
rules.description: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Plaguebound
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Plaguebound, they ignore wounds on rolls of 5-6 from Plaguebound (instead of only on 6+).

rules.name: Enhanced Plaguebound Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Plaguebound. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Protected
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Protected, they ignore wounds on rolls of 5-6 from Protected (instead of only on 6+).

rules.name: Furious
rules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Furious Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Furious. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Mend
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

rules.name: Plaguebound
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Protected
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Rapid Rush
rules.description: This model moves +6" when using Rush actions.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Relentless
rules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Relentless Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Relentless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Scourge
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, enemies count as having taken 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.

rules.name: Scout
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 9” of their deployment zone, over 9” away from non-Scout enemy units. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

rules.name: Scout Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Scout. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Spell Resistance
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

rules.name: Spell Resistance Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Spell Resistance. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Steadfast
rules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

rules.name: Steadfast Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Steadfast. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Versatile Defense
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, pick one effect: the unit either gets +1 to Defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. Note that you may pick a different effect each time the unit is attacked.

rules.name: Versatile Defense Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Versatile Expert
rules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) on their weapons, or get +1 to hit rolls.

spells.name: Aura of Pestilence
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Difficult Terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Blessed Virus
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Rapid Rush once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Plague Boon
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Plaguebound once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Plague Malediction
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 24" in line of sight, which takes 3 hits with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

spells.name: Rapid Putrefaction
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Decimate.

spells.name: Rot Wave
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits.
